1: -module(quod_read_set_SUITE).
    2: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
    3: -include_lib("stdlib/include/assert.hrl").
    4: -include("quod_ledger.hrl").
    5: -export([all/0, init_per_testcase/2, end_per_testcase/2]).
    6: -export([reconnect_mixed_symbols/1, reconnect_missing_route/1,
    7:          reconnect_route_recovery/1, application_reference/2,
    8:          resolve_application/2]).
    9: 
   10: all() -> [reconnect_mixed_symbols, reconnect_missing_route, reconnect_route_recovery].
   11: 
   12: %% Each case owns a fresh three-node fixture. No route is removed or shared
   13: %% with another case, and standalone/combined execution has identical setup.
   14: init_per_testcase(Case, Config) ->
   15:     Dir = filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), atom_to_list(Case)),
   16:     ok = file:make_dir(Dir),
   17:     quod_ask_SUITE:init_per_suite(lists:keystore(priv_dir, 1, Config, {priv_dir, Dir})).
   18: end_per_testcase(_Case, Config) -> quod_ask_SUITE:end_per_suite(Config).
   19: 
   20: reconnect_mixed_symbols(Config) ->
   21:     F = committed_request(Config),
   22:     install_target_route(Config),
   23:     verify_reconnect(Config, F).
   24: 
   25: reconnect_missing_route(Config) ->
   26:     F = committed_request(Config),
   27:     assert_no_route(Config),
   28:     ?assertEqual({error, retry}, resolve_evidence(Config, F)),
   29:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_pending, _}}, reconnect(Config, F)),
   30:     assert_target_fact(Config, F).
   31: 
   32: reconnect_route_recovery(Config) ->
   33:     F = committed_request(Config),
   34:     assert_no_route(Config),
   35:     ?assertEqual({error, retry}, resolve_evidence(Config, F)),
   36:     install_target_route(Config),
   37:     %% Only evidence discovery is retried. The request/signature/claim and
   38:     %% application identity are unchanged; there is no second submission.
   39:     verify_reconnect(Config, F).
   40: 
   41: committed_request(Config) ->
   42:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
   43:     Name = <<"a_readset_reconnect_", (binary:encode_hex(crypto:strong_rand_bytes(12)))/binary>>,
   44:     Symbol = peer:call(Third, erlang, binary_to_atom, [Name, utf8]),
   45:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove,
   46:       [<<"third">>, {assertz, {Symbol, exists}}], 60000)),
   47:     Tag = erlang:unique_integer([positive]),
   48:     Goal = iolist_to_binary(["third::(", Name, "(exists), assertz(readset_committed(",
   49:                             integer_to_binary(Tag), ")))."]),
   50:     Session = ?config(client_session, Config),
   51:     Request = quod_ct:signed_goal_fixture(#{
   52:       target => {<<"pets">>, ?config(asker_anchor, Config)},
   53:       network => ?config(network_id, Config), key_pair => ?config(agent_key, Config),
   54:       operation_id => crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32), goal_text => Goal,
   55:       deadline => min(maps:get(expires_ms, Session), quod_time:now_ms() + 30000)}),
   56:     Bytes = maps:get(request_bytes, Request), Signature = maps:get(signature, Request),
   57:     {ok, Evidence, {normalized, {committed, [_], Ref}}} = peer:call(
   58:       ?config(asker, Config), quod_client_goal_ingress, submit,
   59:       [execute, maps:get(session_id, Session), Bytes, Signature, ?config(client_peer, Config)], 60000),
   60:     {transaction, <<"third">>, _, TxId} = Ref,
   61:     {Certified, TxBytes, Names} = peer:call(Third, ?MODULE, application_reference,
   62:                                          [<<"third">>, TxId]),
   63:     ?assert(lists:member({Name, 1}, Names)),
   64:     ?assert(lists:member({<<"can_invoke">>, 4}, Names)),
   65:     F = #{request => Request, evidence => Evidence, ref => Ref, certified => Certified,
   66:           tx_bytes => TxBytes, name => Name, tag => Tag, session => gateway_session(Config)},
   67:     #{included := Included} = peer:call(?config(asker, Config), quod_ct, await_operation_complete,
   68:       [<<"pets">>, maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence), 5000], 10000),
   69:     ?assertMatch([{_, {certified, Ref, _}}], Included),
   70:     assert_unknown(Config, F),
   71:     F.
   72: 
   73: verify_reconnect(Config, F) ->
   74:     %% S8's result remains a complete vector even for N=1. The target fact,
   75:     %% exact historical application bytes and no-atom-allocation oracles from
   76:     %% the .175 regression are unchanged; no current-view label substitutes.
   77:     ?assertEqual({ok, maps:get(tx_bytes, F)}, resolve_evidence(Config, F)),
   78:     Ref = maps:get(ref, F), Target = quod_operation_vector:target(Ref),
   79:     Evidence = maps:get(evidence, F), Op = maps:get(operation_ref, Evidence),
   80:     {ok, Projection} = peer:call(?config(target, Config), quod_prolog, outcome, [Op]),
   81:     ?assertMatch(#{operation_state := terminal, receipt_height := H} when H > 0, Projection),
   82:     ?assertMatch({ok, _, {operation_outcome, _,
   83:       #{status := completed, targets := [{Target, {committed, Ref}}]}}},
   84:       reconnect(Config, F)),
   85:     assert_unknown(Config, F),
   86:     assert_target_fact(Config, F).
   87: 
   88: resolve_evidence(Config, F) ->
   89:     peer:call(?config(target, Config), ?MODULE, resolve_application,
   90:       [{<<"third">>, ?config(third_anchor, Config)}, maps:get(certified, F)], 10000).
   91: 
   92: resolve_application(Target, Ref) ->
   93:     case quod_foreign_log:resolve_reference(Target, Ref, transaction, none, none,
   94:                                             quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000) of
   95:         {ok, #{transaction := Tx}} -> quod_transaction:encode_ledger_transaction(Tx);
   96:         {error, _} = Error -> Error
   97:     end.
   98: 
   99: reconnect(Config, F) ->
  100:     Request = maps:get(request, F),
  101:     peer:call(?config(target, Config), quod_client_goal_ingress, resolve_operation,
  102:       [maps:get(session_id, maps:get(session, F)), maps:get(request_bytes, Request),
  103:        maps:get(signature, Request), ?config(client_peer, Config)], 15000).
  104: 
  105: assert_target_fact(Config, F) ->
  106:     Third = ?config(third, Config),
  107:     {transaction, _, _, TxId} = maps:get(ref, F),
  108:     ?assertMatch([_], peer:call(Third, quod_ask_SUITE, claim_application_occurrences,
  109:                                [<<"third">>, TxId])),
  110:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_], _}, peer:call(Third, quod_prolog, prove,
  111:       [<<"third">>, {readset_committed, maps:get(tag, F)}], 10000)).
  112: 
  113: assert_unknown(Config, F) ->
  114:     Name = maps:get(name, F),
  115:     ?assertEqual({ok, {'$quod_symbol', Name}}, peer:call(?config(target, Config),
  116:                  quod_wire_term, decode, [{0, Name}])).
  117: 
  118: assert_no_route(Config) ->
  119:     ?assertEqual({error, unavailable}, peer:call(?config(target, Config),
  120:       quod_foreign_log, route_hints, [{<<"third">>, ?config(third_anchor, Config)}, []])).
  121: 
  122: install_target_route(Config) ->
  123:     {ok, _} = peer:call(?config(target, Config), quod_ct, install_directory_generation,
  124:       [?config(third_pub, Config), ?config(third_addr, Config),
  125:        [{<<"third">>, ?config(third_anchor, Config), validator}], 1, 1]),
  126:     ?assertMatch({ok, [_ | _]}, peer:call(?config(target, Config), quod_foreign_log,
  127:       route_hints, [{<<"third">>, ?config(third_anchor, Config)}, []])).
  128: 
  129: application_reference(Ns, TxId) ->
  130:     {ok, #{snapshot := Snapshot, slot := Height, identity := Identity}} =
  131:         quod_simplex:history_view(Ns, any, quod_time:mono_ms() + 5000),
  132:     {ok, Store} = quod_ledger_store:open_ro_snapshot(Snapshot),
  133:     try
  134:         [Result] = quod_ledger_store:fold(Store, 1, Height, fun(Entry, Acc) ->
  135:             case quod_ledger:entry_view(Entry) of
  136:                 #entry{data = {batch, Transactions}} ->
  137:                     lists:foldl(fun(#transaction{tx_id = Id} = Tx, A) when Id =:= TxId ->
  138:                         {ok, Ref} = quod_dtx:certified_entry_ref(Identity, Entry, Tx),
  139:                         {ok, Bytes} = quod_transaction:encode_ledger_transaction(Tx),
  140:                         Names = [{atom_to_binary(Name, utf8), Arity}
  141:                                  || {Name, Arity} <- maps:keys(Tx#transaction.read_check)],
  142:                         [{Ref, Bytes, Names} | A]; (_, A) -> A end, Acc, Transactions);
  143:                 _ -> Acc
  144:             end
  145:         end, []),
  146:         Result
  147:     after quod_ledger_store:close(Store)
  148:     end.
  149: 
  150: gateway_session(Config) ->
  151:     Gateway = ?config(target, Config), KeyPair = ?config(agent_key, Config),
  152:     {Pub, _} = KeyPair, Nonce = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
  153:     {ok, C} = peer:call(Gateway, quod_client_auth, issue_challenge,
  154:                        [Pub, Nonce, ?config(client_peer, Config)]),
  155:     Id = maps:get(challenge_id, C),
  156:     {ok, Bytes} = quod_client_auth:challenge_bytes(?config(network_id, Config),
  157:       ?config(target_pub, Config), Id, Pub, Nonce, maps:get(server_nonce, C), maps:get(expires_ms, C)),
  158:     Sig = quod_identity:sign(Bytes, quod_identity:key_term(KeyPair)),
  159:     {ok, Session} = peer:call(Gateway, quod_client_auth, complete_challenge, [Id, Sig]),
  160:     Session.
